decisions.reason: The lump sum covers site setup. “Liefern und Verlegen” refers to a separate water-main work package, not a new product supplied under this position.
The lump sum covers site setup. “Herstellen” refers to establishing site facilities and utility connections, not supplying a distinct new product.
“Liefern und Verlegen” names the water-main work package in the section heading. This position covers only site setup, not supply of the water main.
